notes.title: Upgrades and improvements ver.0.0.11
notes.content:
✅Flying monsters now don't shoot through buildings when you're inside.
✅Pets will no longer kick the carcass of a boar and a bear.
✅Fixed a bug on quests where you need to raise your pet, give up these quests and take them again.
✅Fixed a bug with loot boxes, after hacking I had to press "E" twice to open it.
✅Fixed a bug in the Forester's quest where you need to talk to the Workshop Boss.
✅The RE-500 scanner was fixed, sometimes it caught a bug and stopped scanning, I had to take it off and put it on again. Now the scanner consumes battery only when scanning and not just while you are holding it in your hands.
✅Now the female character, when overweight, inhales like a woman, not a man.
✅The pet's access to you through its menu is made at a greater distance for convenience.
Fixed a bug with the 3D radar and Energy Shield item, which could be destroyed in the inventory if dressed.
✅Now in aiming mode, you can pick up objects on the "F"
✅ The Time Loop, Contraband Store and Reinforcement Aid widgets now close with the ESC button.
✅Fixed a bug where it was possible to throw an energy shield device or a 3D radar as a grenade from the grenade slot.
✅Now, if you enter the fortification location from the Bunker locations of sector 2,3,4,5 and from the Plasma Cave location, and from the Acid Cave location, you will spawn with your companions and mercenaries near the Hermo doors that you open through the panel, in simple words, the path is shortened so as not to break through the mobs again. 
✅The damage of flying plasma, acid, and fire Grapplers has been reduced.
Additional control points have been added at the locations.
✅Work continues on optimizing and improving gameplay, player requests have been fulfilled, some location issues have been fixed, and preparations are underway to create maps and mini-maps, as well as sort inventory and categories in the craft and store.

✅The RE-500 scanner was fixed, sometimes it caught a bug and stopped scanning, I had to take it off and put it on again. Now the scanner consumes battery only when scanning and not just while you are holding it in your hands.

notes.title: New quests, npcs and abilities.
notes.content:
Greetings dear friends and subscribers. In this update to the game added new mechanics, quests and npcs.
Added 25 new quests, some of these quests you can do in the demo version of the game. Also new nps, some of them are located in locations that are included in the demo version of the game.
Added a third mode of passing the game “One Life”, in which the death of a character starts the game from the beginning.
In “Hardcore” mode you get +1 item bonus for completing quests, and in “One Life” mode you get +3 item bonus.
Now all npcs in the fortification have been given the ability to attack, this is the initial stage of preparation for raids and mass attacks on peaceful fortifications and settlements. Since npcs can now fight, in the coming updates mercenaries will be able to take orders. You will be able to hire a mercenary, and he as a companion will help you in traveling and battles. 
As well as, eliminated some bugs and improved performance, optimized character models. Requests of players, as well as comments were made in the game and corrected flaws. Thanks to everyone who helps the project, my networks are under each video on youtube and even in the game itself, always glad to your messages.

notes.title: New quests, characters and items.
notes.content:

Added more than 15 quests, most of them are available in the Demo version.

Added new items and changed the number of items in the test demo store at the beginning of the game.

Optimization of locations, fps increased, work will be carried out further to improve the client.

notes.title: Devlog #15 Life Effect
notes.content:
Greetings, dear friends and subscribers of the project. A lot of work has been done in the "Effect of Life" project, starting from the addition of many items, and a significant expansion of underground locations. Now I want to tell you about several innovations in the game that will make the game easier for you and give you new opportunities.
1. Items that we can create in crafting are now available for disassembly for spare parts, and not only those items from the crafting list, but also extracted items from the world, such as equipment, drones, weapons, devices and resources. Thus, the weapons or equipment that we are tired of when parsing will give us a second chance to take these spare parts and create another similar equipment or weapons of this series. Disassembling objects has a small chance of damaging parts, as a result of which we may lose
several parts.

2. Added quick access slots for instant use of items, this will allow you to activate equipment, drones and other items without opening inventory. Quick Access slots allow you to quickly react to the use of items in combat or important and dangerous events in the game. Now if you hold an item in the inventory with the left mouse button and start transferring it, all slots where this item can be installed will be highlighted to facilitate equipment, as well as already equipped items in the inventory will be highlighted for instant visual detection.

3. Added the ability to pick up items by clicking the left mouse button on the icon, previously we could pick up items only in a radius around the character, or if there are a lot of items, and for example we don't need to pick up everything, but only the right ones, then it was a little uncomfortable, now with a large amount of loot in one place, we easily choose the items that we need.

4. The first items have been added to strengthen the companion, depending on the characteristics of the injection or the food item, you can increase the characteristics of the creature forever, it can be strength, food, water, health and in the future new added parameters. The companions have added a scale of water consumption, previously there was only food and health. It is planned to add items to strengthen not only the companions, but also the character himself.

5. Earlier in the game development reviews, I showed an enemy scanning system, with which you can find out the parameters of the enemy's strength, health, as well as his weaknesses and a list of items that can be obtained from him, now the ability to scan resources and add them to the database has been added. This way we will be able to know exactly what items are extracted from the resource, its description and characteristics.

6. The corpse of the character now gives you the opportunity to pick up your lost inventory items at death. When a character dies, the entire inventory is transferred to the corpse, you have an hour to return and pick up your things. If a long time passes, only bones remain from the corpse, and after a while it dissolves, and objects will no longer be able to be picked up. Therefore, if a character died among a crowd of monsters and you do not have the opportunity to pick up inventory items, you can go to the base or a cache that will arm itself and recapture things, the corpse is preserved.

A lot has been done recently in the project, a lot of weapons and items have been added, a lot of work is being done on a significant expansion of locations and the creation of an entire underground world. Each of you can help the project, subscribe to the channel, discord server and post comments, suggestions and ideas to improve the game, soon you will all be able to immerse yourself in this universe.

notes.title: Devlog #13 Life Effect
notes.content:
1. Added 10 robots with different types of weapons and mechanics. These robots have two types of movement bases, the first tracked and with mechanisms in the form of spider legs.
Enemy robots will be twice as large in size, destroying them the player will have a chance to get spare parts for crafting their own robot of each type.

2. Added 50 items for farming, crafting and trading.

3. Work has been carried out on optimizing new robots and effects.

This robotics will be used by the alien faction, the military and the player himself. Spawn sites will be designated later, but the task of robots is the defense of fortifications and patrol areas.
Work is underway on other mechanics and features of the game, work on locations, dungeons and bases. Video reviews with information about the progress of the development of mechanics will be published in the news, in the discord community and on the YouTube channel.
